description: Stablecoin payouts a wallet has actually sent, from public block explorers: total, number of transfers, median and largest, how many different wallets received them, repeat recipients, how concentrated they are, the last 30 days, month by month for a year, and days since the last transfer. Built for prop firm payout wallets ('does this firm really pay?'). Ethereum, Arbitrum, Base, Polygon (USDC/USDT) or Tron (USDT, T... address). These are on-chain transfers, not Aevum calls: they can include affiliate, vendor or internal transfers, and nothing confirms who owns the wallet.

address.description: Payout wallet: 0x + 40 hex (EVM) or a Tron address starting with T

name: check_payout_wallet
title: Check a prop firm's payouts
